definitions.gloss: to boil, to simmer, to stew
definitions.explanation: To cook in liquid over heat.

examples.japanese: {大根|だいこん}を{弱火|よわび}で{煮|に}る。
examples.english: To simmer daikon radish on low heat.

examples.japanese: {味|あじ}が{染|し}みるまでじっくり{煮|に}たほうがおいしい。
examples.english: It tastes better if you simmer it slowly until the flavor soaks in.

notes:
{煮|に}る is an ichidan verb meaning to boil, simmer, or stew food in liquid.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {煮|に}える (intransitive, something boils/simmers)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {野菜|やさい}を{煮|に}る: to boil vegetables
- {弱火|よわび}で{煮|に}る: to simmer on low heat
- じっくり{煮|に}る: to simmer slowly
- {味|あじ}が{染|し}みるまで{煮|に}る: to simmer until flavor soaks in

RELATED COOKING TERMS:
- {煮物|にもの}: simmered dish (common Japanese dish)
- {煮込|にこ}む: to stew, simmer for a long time
- {煮|に}つける: to simmer in seasoned liquid
- {煮|に}{出|だ}す: to boil to extract (like stock)

OTHER COOKING VERBS:
- {焼|や}く: to grill, roast, bake
- {炒|いた}める: to stir-fry
- {蒸|む}す: to steam
- {揚|あ}げる: to deep-fry
